title: Assemble the private face-frame dataset onnhqunhh/flag2027-lora-frames-p (FLAG_45 + FLAG_63 frames, renamed *.zipdata)

modes.train: not run by default: collect stages run only when forced (configs/modes.json collect_kind_runs_only_when_forced) and every collected dataset is read from FF_DATA/01_collected (class 'collected' is in always_saved_classes). Re-collecting: force the whole collect closure in ONE run, with a fresh FF_WORK and FF_USE_SAVED=collected (README.md of 11_collect): FF_FORCE=c37_vox2,c53_vox2b,c46_voxblink,c45_frames_vox2,c_frames_index,c63_frames,c87_frames_bridge,c63v_audio_cache. Forcing this stage alone mixes its new rows with the old frames / audio cache (sampling is not deterministic). c87 reads the kernel outputs of c45_frames_vox2 and c63_frames, which are kept nowhere: it can only run in the same run as both of them.

compute.note: original minutes not recorded (unverified); here: hard links or a 7.7 GB copy, no upload

original_inputs_not_attached.why: the original run also attached it for feats_facelora3_b/facelora_ckpt.pt (16 577 607 B), the FLAG_65-b adapter; no stage of this repository produces or reads it (t153b/c resume only from feats_lidstrict_*; e65xbs/e65xcs exclude facelora_ckpt.pt). The runner mounts only 'inputs', so this input is NOT attached and the stage output has 723 files, not the 724 of the published dataset.

notes: The frame zips are renamed *.zipdata (stem kept) so Kaggle does not unpack them; FLAG_153b/c read both names.

No skip_with: the runner serves skip_with as a saved copy of the stage's KERNEL output, and no such copy exists (the FF_DATA/01_collected folders hold the exported datasets, which configs/data_map.json maps by their own ids). The stage is skipped by default because collect stages run only when forced.

Expected output of this stage: 723 files (vox_frames_png.zipdata, frames/frames_manifest.json, frames/vb/*.zipdata 690, frames/vox2b/*.zipdata 31). The published dataset (zip sha256 20cf33248449b40d…, 7 696 444 596 B, 724 files) also holds feats_facelora3_b/facelora_ckpt.pt.

Leftover in FF_DATA/01_collected/face_frames_png: the published copy (data_map) keeps feats_facelora3_b/facelora_ckpt.pt, an unused leftover of FLAG_65-b with no producing stage, never read by the 13.54 chain, private because it was trained on VoxBlink / VoxCeleb2 faces.
